name: Weather Watching
description: Ten small things to notice about the sky and the weather.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Ten cards about noticing the sky and weather, shown on Calm Cards.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Read a card or two and go back to your day.
howToPlay: Read the idea on the card.
Press Show more for a little more detail.
Try it, or press Next for something different.
tips: These are only ideas. If you cannot see outside, skip the card or look at a photo.
